package main

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"errors"
	"log/slog"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"os/signal"
	"syscall"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/application/usecase"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/config"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/infrastructure/adapters"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/infrastructure/persistence/postgres"
	httptransport "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/transport/http"
	_ "github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/stdlib"
)

func main() {
	if err := run(); err != nil {
		slog.Error("practice runtime stopped", "error", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

func run() error {
	settings, err := config.Load()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	database, err := sql.Open("pgx", settings.DatabaseURL)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer database.Close()
	database.SetMaxOpenConns(20)
	database.SetMaxIdleConns(5)
	database.SetConnMaxLifetime(30 * time.Minute)
	startupContext, cancelStartup := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
	err = database.PingContext(startupContext)
	cancelStartup()
	if err != nil {
		return errors.New("PostgreSQL is unavailable")
	}

	client := &http.Client{Timeout: 60 * time.Second}
	runtime := &usecase.Runtime{
		Repository: postgres.NewRepository(database),
		Revisions:  adapters.NewRevisionHTTPClient(settings.CatalogBaseURL, settings.CatalogInternalToken, client),
		Student:    adapters.NewStudentHTTPClient(settings.StudentBaseURL, settings.StudentInternalToken, client),
		Planner:    adapters.NewLearningPlannerHTTPClient(settings.PlannerBaseURL, settings.PlannerInternalToken, client),
		Workspace:  adapters.NewSandboxHTTPClient(settings.SandboxBaseURL, settings.SandboxInternalToken, client),
		Validator:  adapters.NewValidationHTTPClient(settings.ValidationBaseURL, settings.ValidationInternalToken, client),
		Evidence:   adapters.NewStudentHTTPClient(settings.StudentBaseURL, settings.StudentInternalToken, client),
	}

	processContext, stop := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), syscall.SIGINT, syscall.SIGTERM)
	defer stop()
	go runWorker(processContext, time.Second, func(ctx context.Context) error {
		_, err := runtime.ProcessPendingValidations(ctx, 100)
		return err
	})
	go runWorker(processContext, 2*time.Second, func(ctx context.Context) error {
		_, err := runtime.DispatchEvidence(ctx, 100)
		return err
	})

	handler := (&httptransport.Server{Runtime: runtime, InternalToken: settings.InternalToken, TeacherToken: settings.TeacherToken}).Handler()
	server := &http.Server{
		Addr: settings.ListenAddress, Handler: handler,
		ReadHeaderTimeout: 5 * time.Second, ReadTimeout: 15 * time.Second,
		WriteTimeout: 90 * time.Second, IdleTimeout: 60 * time.Second,
	}
	serverError := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { serverError <- server.ListenAndServe() }()

	select {
	case err := <-serverError:
		if errors.Is(err, http.ErrServerClosed) {
			return nil
		}
		return err
	case <-processContext.Done():
		shutdownContext, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		if err := server.Shutdown(shutdownContext); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return nil
	}
}

func runWorker(ctx context.Context, interval time.Duration, work func(context.Context) error) {
	ticker := time.NewTicker(interval)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	for {
		if err := work(ctx); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
			slog.Error("practice runtime background worker cycle failed")
		}
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return
		case <-ticker.C:
		}
	}
}
